answer: Make standing depend on complementarity, not headcount: a reward unlocks only when distinct roles interlock — one identity scouts, another builds, a third verifies — so fifty copies of the same skill are worth no more than one. Like a dune field, a meadow, and an ivory workshop each supplying what the others lack, value comes from difference. A sybil farm cloning one capability starves in its own sameness; its duplicates bid down each other's share instead of multiplying it.
